user.title: Connect to OliveTin
user.description: Enter the OliveTin API URL. Leave username empty and put an API key in the password field to use bearer authentication.

data_description.host: OliveTin API base URL, for example http://olivetin.local:1337/api
data_description.username: Local OliveTin username, or leave empty when using an API key
data_description.password: Local OliveTin password, or API key when username is empty
